response: Saved Views is available today for all customers on paid plans. If you've ever rebuilt the same filtered board or sorted list every morning, this update is for you. Saved Views lets you capture the exact combination of filters, sorting, and grouping you rely on, then return to it in a single click instead of recreating it from scratch. Each user can save up to 50 views, covering every project, client, or workflow you juggle. Views aren't locked to your account either: share any saved view with your team so everyone works from the same setup, whether that's a sprint board, a client status list, or a personal priority queue. Saved Views works across every list in the product, so your favorite combinations are always within reach. Setting it up takes seconds and requires no extra configuration. Whether you manage one project or twenty, Saved Views helps your whole team spend less time organizing and more time doing actual work. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
